items.quote: Fantastic job by On-Top Flooring! I had a ADA Compliant roll-in shower installed and additionally had the entire bathroom floor and closet re-tiled. Ryan and Pedro rock in every way.
We had a great experience with our bathroom remodel! The team was professional, reliable, and paid close attention to detail throughout the entire project.
So very Happy with my new bathroom makeover. This is a great group of hard workers, very maticulious, clean. Good work fair pricing. Thank you all.
